aj: Sharing the latest Figma snapshot for the Usage & Billing page — trying to resolve the visual hierarchy between spend, tokens, and invoices. PTAL: https://figma.com/fake/redwood-spend-v3 :eyes: maria: Nice iteration. My gut — left column = 'Total spend' header + sparkline + month selector. Right column = breakdown (tokens, model cost, infra). Want invoices to be accessible but not compete for attention with spend chart. kevin: Quick backend check — the card shows 'Estimated spend' vs 'Billed spend'? Which calc should we use for the sparkline and total? We need to be explicit to avoid discrepancies with invoices. aj: Good call. For the mock I used 'estimated' (live usage * current price). We can change label. Also thinking about the token breakdown visual: donut vs stacked bars. Donut is compact but conveys proportions poorly for small projects. oliver: +1 on stacked bars for multi-project views. For org view a small sorted bar list is easier to scan. Donut works for single-project quick glance. lisa: One usability nit: default scope. Should we default to org-level for owners and project-level for devs? Or show both with a toggle? Toggle introduces clutter but is explicit. maria: Prefer toggle with clear primary/secondary styling. If we auto-detect, we should still surface the toggle so users can switch. kevin: Implementation note: toggle state lives in query params so deep links work. Also need endpoints to return both org_aggregates and project_breakdown in one call to avoid double fetch. aj: Proposed microcopy for the header: 'Estimated spend — last 30 days'. Thoughts? Sara, finance needs billing-safe language. sara: We must avoid 'estimated' on invoice copy. But on the dashboard 'Estimated spend' is fine if we include an info tooltip explaining it's pre-billing and subject to rounding. Also request: add a CSV export that includes invoice IDs and billing period. aj: Noted. Draft tooltip: 'Estimated spend reflects usage accrued this period and may differ from final invoices.' Should we add a link to billing docs? oliver: Yes — inline link to /docs/billing with a small icon. Also accessibility: color contrast on the green sparkline is failing 3:1 in dark mode. Need color tokens that pass AA. aj: Thanks — I updated colors in the mock. New token: --color-sparkline-strong = #0b6b3a (passes contrast). kevin: Also for screen readers, can we expose the numeric breakdown as a hidden table? For charts we should provide an aria-label and an offscreen CSV link. aj: Proposed snippet for chart a11y: ```html
``` maria: That works. Make sure the aria text is short but complete; we don't want a wall of numbers for AT users. Maybe summarise top 3 and provide a link to full breakdown. sara: On invoices placement: Could we show the three most recent invoices as a compact list under spend and a full 'Invoices' table below the fold? CSV export button near the table. Filename pattern: invoices_org__YYYY-MM.csv aj: Will add sample rows in the mock and include the export button. Also thinking of an affordance to pin invoice to top for admins. oliver: Microcopy tweak: change 'Tokens used' to 'Token consumption' and add per-model breakdown on hover. kevin: For the per-model breakdown we should cap the API response to top N models and return an 'others' bucket to avoid huge payloads. lisa: Analytics ask — can we add a secondary small metric for 'Cost per 1k tokens' on hover? Marketing wants this for shareable screenshots. aj: I can add a hover card with derived metric. Will mock both light and dark variants. design-bot: Snapshot generated: figma_snapshot_1769991234.png (attached) :white_check_mark: maria: Quick final checklist before we lock visuals for dev handoff: 1) confirm label wording (Estimated spend vs Billed), 2) toggle states and default, 3) color tokens updated for accessibility, 4) API changes to support single fetch for aggregates, 5) invoice export naming. kevin: I'll own API changes — will propose a schema in #eng-api later today. sara: I'll draft the invoice CSV spec and share sample data. aj: I'll update the Figma with the small copy tweaks and add the aria snippet to the handoff notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
